description: This file defines types, functions, and constants for managing prompt cache observability, including tracking cache snapshots, detecting changes, and handling cache read events.

methods.name: digestText
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the input string.

methods.name: buildTrackerKey
methods.description: Builds a unique key for a tracker based on sessionKey or sessionId.

methods.name: buildToolDigest
methods.description: Generates a digest for a set of tool names, treating diagnostics as set-stable.

methods.name: setTracker
methods.description: Adds or updates a tracker in the global trackers map, maintaining a maximum size.

methods.name: diffSnapshots
methods.description: Compares two cache snapshots and returns the list of changes.

methods.name: collectPromptCacheToolNames
methods.description: Extracts and trims tool names from an array of tool objects.

methods.name: beginPromptCacheObservation
methods.description: Starts tracking a new prompt cache observation, returning the initial snapshot and changes.

methods.name: completePromptCacheObservation
methods.description: Completes tracking for a cache read, detecting meaningful drops and returning cache break info.

methods.name: resetPromptCacheObservabilityForTest
methods.description: Clears all trackers, used for testing.
